ios.desc:
The MSN app keeps you informed, productive, and entertained with tailored content, real-time weather, stock tracking, short videos and more.​

​Key features​

Your tailored feed, with you on the go.
Quality content from thousands of trusted publishers.​

Weather report​
Get hourly and 10-day forecasts, air quality, UV index and more.​ 

​Financial news​ hub​
See the latest on the market, trends and your favorite stocks. ​

Your personalized video feed​​
Scroll short clips of the latest news, trending stories and viral moments. ​
